_doc: The predicate registry — this repo's baptised vocabulary. Audited by `go run ./tools/agentctl verify` and `go test ./...`. This is the linguistic half of referent conservation: capability_port.md protects the identity of DATA across a boundary; this file protects the identity of WORDS. The same four operations break both.
_family_note: Authoritative, and it obliges every family repo: consult before coining, use the canonical term verbatim, on correction delete the wrong word, cite the path rather than restating entries. Mint here ONLY a referent that is genuinely suite-local and absent from the family registry. A second copy of a family entry is drift, not thoroughness.

rules.one_signifier_one_referent: One signifier, one referent. Two words for one thing is aliasing; one word for two things is equivocal polysemy. Both are forbidden.
rules.on_correction_delete: On correction, DELETE the wrong word — never add a synonym beside it. A synonym left standing is an addition with no retirement: liquefaction at the level of language (docs/ROT.md).
rules.consult_before_coin: Consult the family registry before coining any code signifier — class, field, JSON key, CLI flag, schema name, or technical prose noun.
rules.identity_breaks: Mutation, re-derivation, aliasing and equivocal polysemy are forbidden on predicates exactly as they are on data crossing a port (.claude/skills/cut/references/capability_port.md).

_baptisms_note: Suite-local referents only. A seeded repo fills this for its domain. The template itself mints only the seed-mechanics term package_dir — a referent the family registry does not bind.

baptisms.package_dir: Sanitized filesystem directory name used as cmd/<package_dir>/ and as the default Go module-path basename when seeding a repo from this template. Not an identity key.
baptisms.document_contract: The universal rules that identify a document's lawful carrier, current authority relationship, and prospective adoption boundary without turning observations into a gate.
baptisms.document_contract_projection: A source-identified installation of contract-owned files into an existing repository that refuses to overwrite local divergence.
baptisms.adoption_revision: The Git baseline after which new or subsequently changed operational documents are governed by the document contract.

_banned_note: A retired signifier, with the word that replaced it. `pattern` is a Go regexp; `unless` lists substrings whose presence on the line makes the hit lawful (a longer compound that legitimately contains the retired word).

banned.replacement: package_dir (cmd directory / default module basename); topic (work-report filename fragment)

_wire_debt_note: A place where code still emits a retired signifier, named with the work that will remove it. Named debt is not a baptism, and it is not an exemption — it is a retirement with a date attached.
_exempt_paths_note: Paths the audit does not scan: history, the registry itself (which must quote the retired words in order to ban them), and the test that proves the family-registry cross-check by quoting the retired family entry.
